card.name: The word insert in package insert
card.fires_on: The word "insert" (or "inserts") right after "package" in cross-references such as "see the package insert" for another drug. Weaker on "ate" in excipient names like magnesium stearate.

modes.label: Package insert reference
modes.description: "insert" completes "package insert" when the text sends the reader to another product's labeling.
modes.example: Refer to the package<< insert>> for lithium preparations before use of such preparations

modes.label: Excipient name ending
modes.description: The ending "ate" inside magnesium stearate in an inactive-ingredient list.
modes.example: , gelatin, lactose, magnesium stear<<ate>>, talc, titanium dioxide, car

card.writes: It promotes drug-related words such as drug, drugs and 药物, so it predicts that drug talk follows.
card.plain: It fires on the word "insert" in "package insert" when the label points to another drug's leaflet.
